textbookText: We know that the partial pressure of each gas in a mixture = PT ×mol fraction of that gas
Calculate the total pressure of the gas mixture in 10-L container in the figure given, when both the valves are opened at 27 0C. Also calculate the partial pressure of each gas.
From the ideal gas equation, PV = nRT
Number of mol of gas (nB) = (2×7)/ 0.0821×300=0.5 mol
Total number of mol in the gaseous mixture = 0.7 mol
Total pressure inside the 10L container = Ptot = nRT/V
Partial pressure of A (PA) = mol fraction of A × total pressure (Ptotal) = 0.2 ×1.72 0 .2+ 0. 5
Partial pressure of B(PB)= total pressure (Ptotal) -PA
